Emmanuel Harmon (c 1817-1862) Orphans' Court record Sussex County, Delaware     Submitted by Michael Cannon, who notes, "I am thinking that George W, David W, Nathaniel, Joshua, Morris, Sarah, Eunice, and Robert were all (Emmanuel & Eunice's) children. I think Nathaniel passed away before 1860. I think Robert was a baby and was possibly later adopted by Levi Mosley and his wife Mary.   1. Emmanuel Harmon Jr., born abt 1817 in Delaware; died 1862 in Delaware, son of Emmanuel Harmon and Rachel A. (Johnson) Harmon. He married Eunice (Street) Harmon, born abt 1814 in Delaware; died abt 1862 in Delaware. Children of Emmanuel Harmon Jr. and Eunice Street were as follows:   i John Harmon, born abt 1832. ii George W. Harmon, born abt 19 Mar 1840 in Delaware; died 26 Aug 1913 in near Ellendale, Sussex, Delaware; buried 28 Aug 1913 in Harmony cemetery, near Millsboro, Sussex, Delaware. He married Jane (Collins) Harmon. iii Nathaniel Harmon, born abt 1844 in Delaware. iv Daniel Harmon, born abt 1845 in Delaware. He married Martha ((---)) Harmon. v David W. Harmon, born abt 1846 in Delaware. vi Joshua H. Harmon, born 6 Oct 1848 in Delaware; died 9 Nov 1935 in Magnolia, Kent, Delaware; buried 11 Nov 1935 in Delaware. He married Eliza Jane (Jenkins) Harmon. vii Morris Harmon, born 27 Oct 1852 in Sussex County, Delware; died 30 Jul 1931 in near Milton, Sussex, Delware; buried 1 Aug 1931 in Bethel Cemetery, Milton, Sussex, Delaware. He married Victoria (Hood) Harmon. viii Robert H. or K. or B. Harmon, born abt 1853 in Delaware; died in (no record).
